name: TeamStarWolf - Healthcare Threat Actor Watchlist 2023-2026
description: Enterprise techniques named in the eleven US joint advisories (2022 to 2026) that name the Healthcare and Public Health sector as a victim or carry HHS as an author or co-sealer: ALPHV Blackcat, Black Basta, Rhysida, RansomHub, Interlock, Andariel, Maui, Medusa, Akira, LockBit and Pioneer Kitten. Revoked advisory ids are mapped to their ATT&CK v20 successors through data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl; Mobile ids and the Maui advisory's T1059.008 tag are left out. Tactics are taken from data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. Score = number of advisories naming the technique (1 to 8). Each comment names source numbers from the Sources table of case-studies/HEALTHCARE_THREAT_WATCHLIST.md. Not an official MITRE mapping.

legendItems.label: 8: named in eight (T1486 Data Encrypted for Impact)
